body: a heavy quadruped mecha-ox mount, working farm machine first, full side-profile view, standing on all four legs facing left, legs clearly separated and fully visible (front legs and back legs distinct silhouettes, not overlapping), a sturdy plow-hitch harness mounted on its back (empty, no rider), a broad armored head with real curved ox horns rendered as brushed brass plates, heavy tusked shoulders built for hauling not fighting. Matte warm wheat-gold #e8c45c body plating as the dominant color (not steel-grey, not bronze -- the gold IS the paint), deep barn-red #a13c2e undercarriage and joint housings, a single glowing emerald-green #00ff9c circular gauge-ring on the flank reading like a grain-level gauge, riveted iron joint fittings, dust and loose straw caught around the hooves and knee joints suggesting real field labor. TURTLE'S NOTE: every panel line should look hand-riveted, not seamless sci-fi -- this is agricultural equipment, built by a blacksmith's guild, not a factory. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, warm late-afternoon field lighting (not cold studio light), plain flat neutral background so the ox reads clearly, full body visible nose to tail, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
